6.335 rsDataSetAggregateOfAggregates
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
rsDataSetAggregateOfAggregates is a critical error that will occur when the Scope parameter of an
aggregate function refers to the name of a data set and the Expression parameter of the aggregate
function refers to another aggregate function.
